people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
translations.bsb: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak, and his vitality had not diminished.
translations.kjv: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
translations.asv: And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
